title: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber

entities.name: Sanar
entities.description: A goblin first-year Strixhaven student who bolts from the awakened beast.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: A vampire first-year Strixhaven student with good night vision who leads the group toward daylight.

entities.name: Abigale
entities.description: An owlin first-year student who communicates by signing and telepathic echo and scouts from the air.

entities.name: Tamira
entities.description: A gorgon first-year student who asks Brigid for a place to shelter.

entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: The moon-headed incarnation that was supposed to be sleeping; awakened, it lumbers out dragging darkness and seeding Shadowmoor across Lorwyn.

entities.name: Brigid Baeli
entities.description: A stout kithkin hero in archer's leathers who rescues the students and welcomes them to Lorwyn.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: The daylit side of the plane, to which the students have come.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The nighttime side of the plane, now spreading into Lorwyn's territories.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: The portal that brought the students to Lorwyn; the spreading dark wipes it from the sky.

entities.name: Glen Elendra
entities.description: The stronghold of the faerie queen: a palace built inside a giant flower, ringed by a briar hedge.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: The faerie queen, an avatar of Oona created to mimic a Mornsong elf, who wakes from a bad dream to find a faerie missing.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: The former faerie queen whose death was a gift to the world and who created Maralen.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: An ancient Gilt-Leaf hunter, Maralen's friend and confidant and, if needed, her executioner with a moonglove-drenched dagger.

entities.name: Camey
entities.description: A black-and-brown faerie of Maralen's personal flock of thirty-five who reports Aherin missing.

entities.name: Aherin
entities.description: A faerie of Maralen's flock who has gone missing while someone else uses his bed.

entities.name: Blue faerie
entities.description: The faerie who lured the students through the Omenpath, which changes between blue and green with the aspects and is secretly occupying Aherin's place in the flock.

entities.name: Eirdu
entities.description: The sun incarnation, a six-legged red-and-white beast that lounges in Glen Elendra's courtyard and is Maralen's old friend.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer and planeswalker who is a professor at Strixhaven.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who comes to Liliana to tell her Jace has died and Bolas has escaped.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker mind mage, reported to have been consumed by a spell he lost control of in the Meditation Realm.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker who escaped Ugin's capture via an Omenpath.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker dragon who captured Bolas on Ravnica.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped Ajani stop the dragonstorms on Tarkir.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped Ajani stop the dragonstorms on Tarkir.

entities.name: Dina
entities.description: A Strixhaven teaching assistant who reports the four students missing.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university on Arcavios where Liliana teaches.

entities.name: Meditation Realm
entities.description: The place where Jace was found and where the dragonstorms wracked everything.

entities.name: Phyrexian invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian attack that Kirol recalls was preceded by spontaneous natural spirals.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: The old plane-wide shift between day and night that Brigid says she did not change in.

events.summary: The students flee the darkness and the roaring beast; Sanar bolts first and Abigale escapes into the air.
events.quote: Sanar was the first to turn and bolt.

events.summary: The moon-headed beast emerges from the dolmen gate and plods away, followed by darkness, and Tam staggers out in its wake.
events.quote: the head of the beast emerged through the dolmen gate, the moon at its crown growing brighter as soon as it was in the open air.

events.summary: The four students regroup and run from the spreading night toward patches of daylight.
events.quote: the four students ran for the remains of the day as hard and as fast as they had ever run for anything.

events.summary: A stout archer waves the students toward her across patches of darkness and leads them into an ash forest.
events.quote: Follow me,

events.summary: Brigid asks the students who they are and winces when Abigale's telepathy enters her mind, since they are not part of the thoughtweft.
events.quote: You're not part of the thoughtweft. You're not meant to be there.

events.summary: Brigid introduces herself, explains that people tumble into Lorwyn since the metal invasion, and identifies the beast as Isilu.
events.quote: My name is Brigid Baeli, hero of Kinsbaile, and I'm pleased to welcome you to Lorwyn.

events.summary: Brigid says Isilu should be sleeping, not stomping through Lorwyn and seeding Shadowmoor in their territories.
events.quote: It's supposed to be sleeping right now, not stomping through Lorwyn and seeding Shadowmoor in our territories.

events.summary: The spreading darkness washes over and erases the Omenpath, and Abigale flies up to confirm it is gone.
events.quote: it washed over the iridescent triangle, seemingly wiping it away.

events.summary: Tam asks Brigid for a place to go and Brigid agrees to take them somewhere.
events.quote: I think I do, yes,

events.summary: The blue faerie slips through the briar hedge into Glen Elendra, reverts to a blue Lorwyn faerie in the light and sneaks into Maralen's flock.
events.quote: a small blue Lorwyn faerie stood where the green faerie had been

events.summary: The faerie drops a sprig of foxglove on the sleeping Maralen's pillow.
events.quote: dropping its sprig of foxglove onto the pillow of the figure sleeping there.

events.summary: Maralen wakes from a terrible dream, sensing something is very wrong.
events.quote: With a gasp, Maralen awoke and sat upright in her bed

events.summary: Camey reports that the faerie Aherin is missing and that someone is using his bed, making the flock seem to number thirty-five.
events.quote: But now there are thirty- four of us, and Aherin is missing

events.summary: Rhys visits Maralen, who is reminded of the pact by which he would kill her if she followed Oona's path.
events.quote: Should she show any sign that her slow transformations had started to lead her down her creator's path, Rhys would kill her

events.summary: Maralen briefly sees a third figure of living flower petals in her mirror and hears ghostly laughter, which Rhys cannot hear.
events.quote: it looked like there was a third person in the room with them, smaller, made entirely of living flower petals and glaring at her with unending menace.

events.summary: Maralen flees to the courtyard to find comfort with Eirdu.
events.quote: Hello, old friend,

events.summary: As Eirdu leaves, patches of Shadowmoor open in the courtyard, and the blue faerie transforms back to green and follows Maralen.
events.quote: letting its transformation repeat in reverse, blue becoming green, smoothness becoming jagged and ornate.

events.summary: Ajani arrives at Liliana's office at Strixhaven; she guesses someone has died.
events.quote: Who died?

events.summary: Ajani tells Liliana that Jace has died.
events.quote: It was such a small word.

events.summary: Ajani recounts that Jace lost control of an unidentifiable spell in the Meditation Realm and dissolved into light and energy.
events.quote: The spell took him, and he was gone. Just light and energy on the wind.

events.summary: Ajani reveals that Jace had let Bolas be captured by Ugin and then Bolas escaped through an Omenpath.
events.quote: So Bolas escaped.

events.summary: Liliana's teacup shatters as she absorbs the news.
events.quote: Her teacup shattered as it hit the floor.

events.summary: Dina bursts in to report that four students are missing after following a flying creature down an Omenpath.
events.quote: We think they fell down an Omenpath, but it closed before we could go after them.

events.summary: Ajani offers to try to find the missing students and goes with Dina to the site.
events.quote: I can certainly try,

relations.note: Oona created Maralen as an avatar, who rejected her maker.
relations.quote: As an avatar of Oona who rejected her maker so vociferously

relations.note: Friend and confidant, and her designated executioner.
relations.quote: He was her friend, her confidant

relations.note: Glen Elendra is home and holding of Queen Maralen of the fae.
relations.quote: now home and holding of Queen Maralen of the fae
To be beloved of Eirdu was to be beloved of the sun in all its impossible vastness.

relations.note: Liliana once loved him but no longer does.
Ajani warns that Bolas has escaped and does not know where she is.
relations.quote: he doesn't know where you are.
he let Ugin capture Bolas at the same time
Professor Vess, four of the students I took out with me today are missing!
